title: My Morning Jacket Signs With CAA
summary: The Kentucky band has signed with the agency following the release of its 2025 studio album, Is.
contentText:
My Morning Jacket has joined the CAA roster, it was announced on Thursday (Jan. 22). The Kentucky-bred band will be represented worldwide by the agency following its departure from UTA.

My Morning Jacket, which has been a band for nearly 30 years, released its most recent collection,  Is,  in 2025. That album was produced by multiple Grammy-award-winning producer Brendan O’Brien, who has worked with rock greats including Bruce Springsteen and Pearl Jam . It reached the top 20 of Billboard ‘s Top Rock Albums chart.

The Grammy-nominated band has had 12 albums chart on the Billboard 200, including two top 10s:  Evil Urges  (2008) and  Circuital  (2011). Of those 12 albums, seven have also charted on the Top Rock Albums chart.

My Morning Jacket has also notched six top 10s on Billboard ‘s Adult Alternative Airplay chart, with three going to No. 1, including two hits from last year: “Time Waited” and “Everyday Magic.” The band’s song catalog has registered 545 million official on-demand U.S. streams, according to Luminate.

From 2008 to 2015, the band had three consecutive albums —  Evil Urges  (2008),  Circuital  (2011) and  Waterfall  (2015) — receive Grammy nominations for best alternative album.

Over the course of My Morning Jacket’s long career, it has sold out headline tours and top-billed multiple festivals. In 2025, the band was inducted into the Austin City Limits Hall of Fame by the legendary writer-director Cameron Crowe . Other acts inducted into the Austin City Limits Hall of Fame include Willie Nelson , Stevie Ray Vaughan , Garth Brooks , Loretta Lynn  and Bonnie Raitt .

My Morning Jacket is managed by Michael McDonald and Kristen Bunk at Mick Management.
